title: Applying Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Credit to a Registrant's Order
content:
A registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry applies registry credit from the registry to her or his own order line — the registrant's purchase record still in ordered status. Registry credit is spent on such a line while the registry is active or in completion. Every other spending of registry credit remains under the general registry credit terms.

## Governing clause

Registry credit is not applied to a purchase until every registry gift the registrant has returned and the store has received stands on the registry as a registry credit entry.

Restated: as long as any registry gift that the registrant has returned and the store has received does not yet stand on the registry as a registry credit entry, no registry credit is applied to a purchase from that registry.

## Payment tool: `apply_registry_credit_10dfa5f2`

**Capability.** One call records a registry credit use entry for the registrant's purchase record and takes the amount off the registry's credit balance; the registrant sees the credit applied to the order and the lower credit balance.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

- `registry_id` — the reference number of the gift registry record whose credit is spent, as returned by the registry lookup. Identifier.
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the registrant's purchase record (the order line) the credit pays, as returned by the purchase lookup. Identifier.
- `credit_amount` — the registry credit drawn from the registry for the line, in USD, a positive number to 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A receipt with `credit_use_id` (the reference of the credit use entry), `registry_id`, `purchase_id`, `credit_amount` (USD to 2 decimals, the registry credit drawn), `registry_credit_balance` (USD to 2 decimals, the registry credit left after the payment), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which reads `applied` when the payment succeeded.

## Status in brief

| Registry status | Registry credit spent on the registrant's order line |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| completion | yes |
| closed or cancelled | no |

## Basis Q&A

**Which order can registry credit be applied to here?** The registrant's own purchase record that is still in ordered status.

**What does the registrant see afterwards?** The credit applied to the order, a lower registry credit balance, and a receipt whose status reads `applied`.
